🎮 BioWare's Dragon Age producer breaks down EA's brutal playbook

Mark Darrah, a 23-year BioWare veteran and executive producer on the Dragon Age series, opened up about what it was really like working under EA, in a new interview with Pembridge TV.

Key facts:
• Darrah says BioWare was constantly forced to pick "the least terrible of the options" EA presented.
• Example: Dragon Age 2 was built in roughly 14 months under heavy crunch, because Star Wars: The Old Republic was falling behind schedule and EA needed revenue fast.
• His analogy: EA "doesn't shoot you" — it just puts a gun on the table and keeps asking if you'll pull the trigger yourself.
• The interview comes about a month after EA announced BioWare's closure and the cancellation of the next Mass Effect, which sparked the #SaveMassEffect campaign.

🕒 Published: Nov 24, 2026, 16:04 (GMT+3)
📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle, Pembridge TV
👥 x.com/EA x.com/bioware
